text: POSCO HOLDINGS INC. (formerly POSCO) lists POSCO COATED & COLOR STEEL Co., Ltd. (56.87%) and Myanmar POSCO C&C Company, Limited (70.00%, held through subsidiaries) among its subsidiaries in its 2021 consolidated financial statements. The Korea Herald (April 2021) calls Posco C&C an affiliate of Posco that owns 70% of its joint venture with MEHL, Myanmar Posco C&C, and reports it said it would buy MEHL's 30% to end the partnership.
short: POSCO Holdings' group owns 70% of Myanmar POSCO C&C, its joint venture with MEHL.

additionalSources.name: [Newsmaker] Posco C&C severs ties with Myanmar’s military conglomerate MEHL - The Korea Herald
additionalSources.quote: The affiliate of South Korea’s steel giant Posco said it will end its partnership with MEHL by purchasing all the stakes MEHL has in their joint venture, Myanmar Posco C&C Co.
additionalSources.note: The same article: 'The steel product manufacturer owns a 70 percent of stake in the joint venture, and it will purchase the remaining 30 percent held by MEHL'.
